title: Hasan Imame Hasan
body:
hassan imam e hassan yabnaz zahra
maula hassan sabz qaba sayyedi maula
<<DIVIDER>>
panjetani panjateni panjetani ya hassani
ya hassan ya hassan ya hassan imam hassan
<<DIVIDER>>
gulshan e zehra ka hassan phool hai pehla
nana mohamed ka nawasa hai ye pehla
maula ali ko hai mila laal ye pyara
<<DIVIDER>>
hassan imam e hassan yabnaz zahra
panjetani panjateni panjetani ya hassani
ya hassan ya hassan ya hassan imam hassan
<<DIVIDER>>
inki fazeelat mein hai kaafi yehi kehna
kehte imam unko hai shabbir bhi apna
aisa bada bhai nahi hoga dobara
<<DIVIDER>>
hassan imam e hassan yabnaz zahra
maula hassan sabz qaba sayyedi maula
ya hassan ya hassan ya hassan imam hassan
<<DIVIDER>>
aap ki mehman nawazi ke hai charche
koi na bhooka hai gaya aap ke dar se
aisa saqi shaah ko hai zehr se maara
<<DIVIDER>>
hassan imam e hassan yabnaz zahra
panjetani panjateni panjetani ya hassani
ya hassan ya hassan ya hassan imam hassan
<<DIVIDER>>
rote hai abbas bhi qasim ko sambhale
zainab o kulsoom ke shabbir ke naale
tukde jigar le ke chala bhai hamara
<<DIVIDER>>
hassan imam e hassan yabnaz zahra
maula hassan sabz qaba sayyedi maula
ya hassan ya hassan ya hassan imam hassan
<<DIVIDER>>
uth'ta hai taboot mere maula hassan ka
teeron se chalni hai janaza bhi hassan ka
kitne sitam sehta raha maula hamara
<<DIVIDER>>
hassan imam e hassan yabnaz zahra
panjetani panjateni panjetani ya hassani
ya hassan ya hassan ya hassan imam hassan
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ka shabbir ne taboot uthaya
haye kafan bhi nahi shabbir ne paaya
qalb e hassan sabz qaba paara hai paara
<<DIVIDER>>
hassan imam e hassan yabnaz zahra
maula hassan sabz qaba sayyedi maula
ya hassan ya hassan ya hassan imam hassan
